prompt: Why do you think the United Nations had to step in to make the Outer Space Treaty? Why might both the United States and the USSR have decided to go along with it in space race? Each sentence must have more alliterative words than the previous one.
judge_reasoning: All candidates address the two requested motivations (why the UN stepped in and why the US/USSR would agree), but only some appear to satisfy the mechanical constraint of strictly increasing alliterative-word counts per sentence. Candidate 3 most clearly maintains a rising alliteration pattern across all four sentences while staying on-task. Candidate 2 also largely matches the increasing-alliteration requirement and answers both parts, but the first motivation is more general and the alliteration increase is less transparent. Candidate 1 likely breaks the monotonic alliteration trend by switching/contracting the dominant alliterative set in the final sentence, and Candidate 4 clearly fails it (sentence 2 has far fewer alliterative words than sentence 1).
